enrichment.summary: The board is approving, after the work began, a contract with LA Fowler, LLC to help the Nutrition Services Department and central office leaders build a full Central Kitchen implementation plan. It covers pilot sites, technology, purchasing, staffing, budget, training and a 3-5 year strategic plan, built with input from people inside and outside the district. The contract runs October 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and is capped at $63,000.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Professional Services Contract - LA Fowler, LLC - Office of the Chief of Staff

enrichment.headline: Adds $11,823 to Girls Inc's after-school staff training agreement at LaEscuelita Elementary
enrichment.summary: This amendment raises the agreement's cap from $137,756 to $149,579. Girls Inc of Alameda County funds weekly professional development for after school staff, on topics such as coding, behavior management and supporting English Language Learners, at LaEscuelita Elementary's after school program. The period runs August 1, 2019 through July 31, 2020.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
